required_inputs.instruction: I need Tool/backend mapping for FortiOS v7.2.12: the call is hitting path {path:'firewall', name:'sessions'} and the FortiGate returns HTTP 404 (endpoint not found). This is not correctable via input arguments; it indicates the API endpoint/resource the tool uses is unavailable/unsupported on this device/firmware or the tool is using the wrong API path.; Confirmation of the correct FortiGate API endpoint for listing sessions on this platform (e.g., whether it should be a /monitor/firewall/session* endpoint) and whether the tool supports FortiOS v7.2.12 build 1761 for session listing.; If sessions are VDOM-scoped in your environment: the required VDOM/tenant context for fgt_druidics (not present in the tool schema, but may be required by the backend implementation).; API account/permissions used by the tool for fgt_druidics (even though permission issues usually return 401/403, not 404, it should be validated alongside endpoint support). to execute 'fgt_monitor_fw_get_firewall_sessions' on fgt_druidics.
